description: This file defines the 'Resource' class within the SuiteCRM JSON API implementation, handling JSON API resource objects including parsing requests, managing attributes, relationships, and generating responses.

classes.name: Resource
classes.description: Represents a JSON API resource object, capable of parsing requests, managing attributes and relationships, and generating responses according to JSON API specifications.

methods.name: fromJsonApiRequest
methods.description: Parses a JSON API request array to populate the Resource object, handling 'id', 'type', attributes, and relationships.

methods.name: mergeAttributes
methods.description: Merges attributes from another Resource object into this one.

methods.name: toJsonApiResponse
methods.description: Generates a full JSON API response array including all attributes.

methods.name: toJsonApiResponseWithFields
methods.description: Generates a JSON API response array including only specified fields.

methods.name: withLinks
methods.description: Sets the links object for the resource.

methods.name: withRelationship
methods.description: Adds a relationship to the resource.

methods.name: getReservedKeywords
methods.description: Returns the list of reserved keywords in JSON API.

methods.name: validateResource
methods.description: Validates that the resource has 'id' and 'type' set.

methods.name: relationshipFromDataArray
methods.description: Processes relationship data from input array, validating and setting relationships.

methods.name: attributesFromDataArray
methods.description: Extracts and filters attributes from input data array.
